meta.name: secrets-management
meta.description: Implement secure secrets management for CI/CD pipelines using Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or native platform solutions. Use when handling sensitive credentials, rotating secrets, or securing CI/CD environments.

copy.tagline: 把流水线里的密钥和令牌统一保管起来并定期轮换,降低泄露风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 CI/CD 里散落着明文密钥,想集中保管并自动轮换。
copy.tagline_en: Store pipeline secrets in a vault and rotate them on a schedule
copy.fit_line_en: For you if plaintext keys are scattered across your CI/CD pipelines and need central rotation.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你把 CI/CD 里的密钥集中管理:用 Vault、AWS Secrets Manager 等存 API key、数据库密码和证书,配置自动轮换、日志掩码、最小权限,并给出流水线配置片段。
howto.when: 当你处理敏感凭据、轮换密钥,或在 CI/CD 环境中配置密钥安全时接管。也覆盖存储 API key、数据库密码等场景。

say.text: 我要用 AWS Secrets Manager 存生产库密码,并设置自动轮换。
say.note: 会给出创建密钥与 Lambda 轮换步骤。

say.text: 帮我加个提交前扫描,发现密钥就阻止提交。
say.note: 会用 TruffleHog 写 pre-commit 钩子。

howto.what_en: Claude manages secrets in your CI/CD pipelines: stores API keys, database passwords and certificates in Vault, AWS Secrets Manager and similar tools, sets up rotation, log masking and least-privilege access, and writes the pipeline config.
howto.when_en: Takes over when you handle sensitive credentials, rotate secrets, or secure CI/CD environments. Also covers storing API keys and database passwords.

say_en.text: Read the database password from Vault in this GitHub Actions pipeline.
say_en.note: Writes vault-action read and masking config.

say_en.text: Store the production DB password in AWS Secrets Manager and enable rotation.
say_en.note: Gives create-secret and Lambda rotation steps.

say_en.text: Add a pre-commit scan that blocks commits containing secrets.
